data.narrative: The student demonstrated masterful systems-level debugging and distributed architectural diagnosis in Module 06. They successfully navigated two insidious multi-layer failures: identifying the contract omission between database deletion and Redis cache invalidation (Bug #9), and tracing a complex 12-step cascading failure from an unbounded queue worker retry storm to shared database connection pool exhaustion that froze the entire API (Bug #10). Furthermore, when cache invalidation triggered a secondary namespace collision bug in queue deduplication during the BREAK step, they correctly diagnosed the shared Redis key anti-pattern and implemented strict domain key segregation.

dimension_scores.observation: Formulated precise architectural hypotheses distinguishing between layer-internal failures and handoff contract omissions, correctly predicting cache-aside staleness and connection pool starvation.
dimension_scores.evidence: Documented hypothesis testing comparing direct database queries against Redis cache state and CPU profiling in progress/debugging/module-06-diagnosis.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Traced the 12-step causal chain of Bug #10 from individual worker job failure through exponential backoff absence, connection checkout spin loops, shared pool starvation, and API probe failure, rejecting superficial fixes like increasing pool size.
dimension_scores.evidence: Detailed causal cascade and bulkhead architecture in progress/debugging/module-06-verification.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Reconstructed the exact lifecycle of link deletion and recreation to isolate the BREAK bug where queue deduplication shared the redirect cache key space.
dimension_scores.evidence: Demonstrated the interaction sequence and verified isolated key namespaces in progress/debugging/module-06-break.md and progress/debugging/module-06-fix.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Analyzed connection pool metrics and driver wait queues to diagnose why an apparently healthy Node.js process failed to respond despite low CPU utilization.
dimension_scores.evidence: Evaluated wait queue depth as the earliest high-fidelity telemetry signal in progress/debugging/module-06-verification.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Communicated technical findings clearly across system layers, articulating how unisolated shared resources create invisible architectural couplings.
dimension_scores.evidence: Synthesized the shared resource principle across cache keys, queues, and connection pools in progress/debugging/module-06-diagnosis.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Delivered comprehensive, multi-layer preventive solutions: explicit cache invalidation, BullMQ exponential backoff with DLQ retention, connection pool limits, and namespace segregation.
dimension_scores.evidence: Implemented robust production fixes across src/links/links.service.ts, src/analytics/analytics.queue.ts, and src/cache/cache.service.ts.

strengths: Demonstrated exceptional multi-layer systems thinking, recognizing that components can be individually correct while the system is architecturally broken.
Diagnosed and resolved cascading connection pool exhaustion using the bulkhead pattern and exponential backoff.
Enforced strict key namespace separation to prevent cross-system cache collisions.

public_evidence.student_action: Diagnosed and resolved distributed multi-layer production bugs: stale cache redirects, queue retry connection storms, and cache namespace collisions.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Redis cache invalidation, BullMQ exponential backoff, dead-letter queue routing, connection pool bulkhead isolation, and key namespace segregation.
public_evidence.proof: Verified that link deletions immediately 404, queue worker failures never starve API database connections, and link re-creations maintain exactly-once event processing.
public_evidence.ability: Diagnoses, reproduces, and resolves complex multi-layer distributed system failures spanning APIs, caches, queues, and connection pools.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Exhibits senior infrastructure and distributed systems debugging capabilities, identifying non-local failure cascades and establishing resilient bulkhead boundaries.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Implemented transactional cache invalidation on link deletion
Added exponential backoff and max retry limits to background queue workers
Separated database connection pools and bounded worker concurrency

teaching_approaches.detail: Traced 12-step failure chain from background job error to public API starvation
